title: v4.1.1 direct OpenClaw Ollama configuration without onboarding
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; $cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path $cfg){$bak=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-config-before-049r'; if(Test-Path $bak){Remove-Item $bak -Recurse -Force}; Copy-Item $cfg $bak -Recurse -Force}; Write-Output 'V411_049R_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $d=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'discovery.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $models=@($d.ollamaTags); if($models.Count -lt 1){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'}; $preferred=@('qwen3:8b','qwen2.5-coder:14b','mistral-nemo','deepseek-r1:14b'); $model=$null; foreach($p in $preferred){if($models -contains $p){$model=$p;break}}; if(-not $model){$model=[string]$models[0]}; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_API_KEY','ollama-local','User'); $env:OLLAMA_API_KEY='ollama-local'; & openclaw config set models.providers.ollama.apiKey 'OLLAMA_API_KEY' 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OLLAMA_APIKEY_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw models set ('ollama/'+$model) 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'model-set-049r.txt') | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_MODEL_SET_FAILED'}; $model | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Encoding ASCII; Write-Output ('V411_049R_MODEL='+$model)
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $m=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'selected-model.txt') -Raw).Trim(); $list=& openclaw models list --provider ollama 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OPENCLAW_OLLAMA_LIST_FAILED'}; $list | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'models-049r.txt') -Encoding UTF8; if($list -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw 'SELECTED_MODEL_NOT_VISIBLE'}; if($list -match '/v1'){throw 'OPENCLAW_USING_V1_ENDPOINT'}; Write-Output 'V411_049R_TEST=PASS'
